items.title: Crypto traders are in risk-on mode as bitcoin dominance nears return to 60%
items.summary: Bitcoin dominance is closing in on 60% while USDT's has slipped to 6.3%, pointing to a market growing more comfortable with risk.

items.title: MetaMask security incident forces Ethereum staking exits, no funds at risk
items.summary: An Ethereum security researcher estimates about 0.36 ETH in rewards was diverted, while precautionary exits cover validators holding roughly 523,000 ETH.

items.title: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed
items.summary: Highly liquid and settling 24/7, stablecoins can leave banks and countries at lightning speed. But whether stablecoins are a risk — or an opportunity — depends on your perspective.

items.summary: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.
